name: Sakagami Habaki
source:
A cheerful man, who arrived from the countryside by [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Mikado Ryuumei[/url] directive. He appeared in the middle of the Fencing Kagura ceremony after it was disturbed by [url=https://vndb.org/c34797]Koga Rindou Suzuka[/url], and became her loyal vassal. He has fallen in love with her and has become ready to die for her. Yet she retorted and said that his life was not only his own, and so he should not die so lightly.

[spoiler]His true desire is to [b]"live"[/b]. [i]He desired to live more than anyone else.[/i]

In the beginning, he had no name. He had neither hands, nor legs, nor even eyes, nose, or ears. His true form was a [b]teratoma[/b] in [url=https://vndb.org/c34838]Hajun[/url]'s body. He was an unneeded being, one that would be gotten rid of if found. So he tried to hide as hard as he could, covering himself in fear.

Because his host was [url=https://vndb.org/c34838]Hajun[/url], the power of Shinza flowed into him. He felt danger of being found, so "Sakagami Habaki" was created.[/spoiler]

[spoiler][i]"Sakagami Habaki" was only his mental image, that he brought to the world.[/i][/spoiler]
